name: cloudrepublic/shield-mfa-dispatcher
description: Lets a CodeIgniter Shield app offer several MFA methods (email, WhatsApp, TOTP, passkey, ...) and switch a user between them programmatically, despite Shield's Auth::$actions only accepting one class.

suggest.cloudrepublic/shield-whatsapp-mfa: Adds a 'whatsapp' method option, plus self-service phone verification on the settings page built into this package.
suggest.cloudrepublic/shield-totp-mfa: Adds a 'totp' method option, plus self-service enrollment on the settings page built into this package.
suggest.cloudrepublic/shield-passkey-mfa: Adds a 'passkey' method option for the login step - its own self-service enrollment page (account/passkeys) isn't currently integrated into this package's settings page the way TOTP's is, so link to it separately.
